blocks.text: The regular arrangement of ions, atoms, or molecules in three dimensional space is called the crystall lattice.
highlight: The regular arrangement of ions, atoms, or molecules in three dimensional space is called the crystall lattice.

blocks.text: The solids which have definite regular and three dimensional geometric shapes are called crystalline solids. For example, diamond, sodium chloride, ice, etc.
